title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
description:
Motivation: provide opinionated RAG agent templates and a set of TypeScript/Python tool-calling examples to help teams get started quickly. This PR bundles: 1) RAG agent templates (policy + prompt + example prompts), 2) tool-calling quickstarts demonstrating web API and DB lookups, and 3) docs site updates (guide, quickstart page, and sidebar). Changes are broken out so reviewers can focus on examples first and docs later.

What this includes:
- redwood-examples/rag/templates: agent templates for FAQ, customer-support, and research-assistant workflows (config + prompts + sample inputs).
- redwood-examples/rag/tool-calling: two minimal quickstarts (TS and Py) demonstrating tool registration, function schemas, and safe fallback behavior when tools fail.
- redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-quickstart.md: new guide with step-by-step instructions and 'How it works' diagrams.
- redwood-docs/static/sidebar.yml: add RAG quickstart under Guides -> Agents.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates and sample prompts
- [x] Add TS and Python tool-calling quickstarts with minimal dependencies
- [x] Update docs site and sidebar entries
- [x] Add unit tests for example tool wrappers
- [x] Run docs site build and linkchecks

Notes on scope: examples are intentionally minimal (small memory footprint) and wired to the redwood SDK interfaces; they are intended as quickstarts, not production-ready code. Follow ups (tracked in ENG-4821): add end-to-end test harness, expand template variants, and include additional languages.

Related: Linear ENG-4821, PM-124. Linked support ticket SUP-943 (customer requested quickstarts for tool-calling).
